title.zh: 卷一百 列傳第三十: 耶律棠古 蕭得里底 蕭酬斡 耶律章奴 耶律朮者
title.en: Volume 100 Biographies 30: Yelu Tanggu, Xiao Delidi, Xiao Chouwo, Yelu Zhangnu, Yelu Paizhe
title.raw: 卷一百 列傳第三十: 耶律棠古 蕭得里底 蕭酬斡 耶律章奴 耶律朮者 Volume 100 Biographies 30: Yelu Tanggu, Xiao Delidi, Xiao Chouwo, Yelu Zhangnu, Yelu Paizhe

sentences.zh: 耶律棠古蕭得裏底蕭酬斡耶律章奴耶律術者

translations.literal: Yelü Tanggu, Xiao Delidi, Xiao Chouwo, Yelü Zhangnu, Yelü Paizhe
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Tanggu, Xiao Delidi, Xiao Chouwo, Yelü Zhangnu, and Yelü Paizhe

sentences.zh: 耶律棠古，字蒲速宛，六院郎君葛剌之後。

translations.literal: Yelü Tanggu, courtesy name Pusuwan, was a descendant of Gela, a langjun of the Six Tribes.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Tanggu, whose courtesy name was Pusuwan, was descended from Gela, a langjun of the Six Tribes.

sentences.zh: 大康中，補本班郎君，累遷至大將軍。

translations.literal: In the Dakang era he was appointed a standard-attendant langjun and was promoted in succession to grand general.
translations.idiomatic: During the Dakang reign he entered service as a standard-attendant langjun and rose in due course to the rank of grand general.

sentences.zh: 性坦率，好別白黑，人有不善，必盡言無隱，時號「強棠古」。

translations.literal: His nature was frank; he liked to distinguish right from wrong, and when anyone did wrong he was sure to speak out fully without concealment, so that at the time he was called "Stubborn Tanggu."
translations.idiomatic: He was forthright by nature and quick to distinguish right from wrong; whenever he saw misconduct he spoke out plainly and held nothing back, for which men of the day nicknamed him "Stubborn Tanggu."

sentences.zh: 在朝數論宰相得失，由是久不得調，後出為西北戍長。

translations.literal: At court he repeatedly discussed the merits and faults of the chief ministers, and for this reason went long without reassignment; later he was sent out as commander of the northwest frontier garrison.
translations.idiomatic: At court he repeatedly aired his views on the chief ministers' conduct, and for this he languished long without promotion until he was finally posted as commander of a northwest frontier garrison.

sentences.zh: 乾統三年，蕭得裏底為西北路招討使，以後族慢侮僚吏。

translations.literal: In the third year of Qiantong, Xiao Delidi served as pacification commissioner of the Northwest Route and, relying on his ties to the empress's clan, treated his subordinate officials with contempt.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Qiantong, Xiao Delidi became pacification commissioner of the Northwest Route and, trading on his connection to the empress's clan, treated his fellow officials with arrogance.

sentences.zh: 棠古不屈，乃罷之。

translations.literal: Tanggu would not yield, whereupon Delidi dismissed him.
translations.idiomatic: Tanggu refused to submit, and Delidi thereupon had him removed from office.

sentences.zh: 棠古訟之朝，不省。

translations.literal: Tanggu brought suit at court, but the matter was not investigated.
translations.idiomatic: Tanggu appealed to the court, but no inquiry was made.

sentences.zh: 天慶初，烏古敵烈叛，召拜烏古部節度使。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tianqing, the Wugu and Dilie tribes rebelled, and he was summoned and appointed military commissioner of the Wugu tribe.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tianqing reign, when the Wugu and Dilie tribes rose in revolt, he was recalled and appointed military commissioner of the Wugu tribe.

sentences.zh: 至部，諭降之。

translations.literal: On reaching his command, he instructed them to submit.
translations.idiomatic: Upon taking up his post he persuaded them to surrender.

sentences.zh: 遂出私財及發富民積，以振其困乏，部民大悅，加鎮國上將軍。

translations.literal: He then spent his private wealth and opened the stores of wealthy households to relieve their destitution; the tribesmen were greatly pleased, and he was advanced to Suppressing-the-State Senior General.
translations.idiomatic: He then drew on his own funds and called up the reserves of wealthy households to relieve their hardship, winning the deep gratitude of the tribesmen and promotion to Suppressing-the-State Senior General.

sentences.zh: 會蕭得裏底以都統率兵與金人戰敗績，棠古請以軍法論。

translations.literal: It happened that Xiao Delidi, as supreme commander, led troops against the Jin and suffered defeat; Tanggu requested that he be judged by military law.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiao Delidi, serving as supreme commander, led the army against the Jin and met with defeat, Tanggu asked that he be tried under military law.

sentences.zh: 且曰：「臣雖老，願為國破敵。」

translations.literal: He also said, "Though your servant is old, he is willing to break the enemy for the state."
translations.idiomatic: He added, "Though I am old, I am still willing to smash the enemy for the realm.

sentences.zh: 不納。

translations.literal: His proposal was not accepted.
translations.idiomatic: His offer was not accepted.

sentences.zh: 保大元年，乞致仕。

translations.literal: In the first year of Baoda he requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Baoda he asked to retire from office.

sentences.zh: 明年，天祚出奔，棠古謁於倒塌嶺，為上流涕，上慰止之，復拜烏古部節度使。

translations.literal: The next year, when Tianzuo fled, Tanggu met him at Daotao Ridge, wept before the emperor, and the emperor comforted and restrained him; he was again appointed military commissioner of the Wugu tribe.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, when Emperor Tianzuo took flight, Tanggu met him at Daotao Ridge and wept before the throne; the emperor comforted him and stayed his grief, then reappointed him military commissioner of the Wugu tribe.

sentences.zh: 及至部，敵烈以五千人來攻，棠古率家奴擊破之，加太子太傅。

translations.literal: When he again reached his command, the Dilie came to attack with five thousand men; Tanggu led his household retainers and defeated them, and was advanced to heir-apparent grand tutor.
translations.idiomatic: On returning to his post, the Dilie attacked with five thousand men; Tanggu led his household retainers, routed them, and was promoted to heir-apparent grand tutor.

sentences.zh: 年七十二卒。

translations.literal: He died at the age of seventy-two.
translations.idiomatic: He died at seventy-two.

sentences.zh: 女直初起，廷臣多欲乘其未備，舉兵往討，得裏底獨沮之，以至敗衄。

translations.literal: When the Jurchens first rose, many at court wished to take advantage of their unreadiness and send troops to punish them; Delidi alone obstructed this, with the result that defeat followed.
translations.idiomatic: When the Jurchens first rose, many at court urged a strike while they were still unprepared, but Delidi alone blocked the plan, and defeat was the outcome.

sentences.zh: 天祚以得裏底不合人望，出為西南面招討使。

translations.literal: Tianzuo, because Delidi did not accord with public expectation, sent him out as Southwest Route pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Because Delidi had lost public confidence, Tianzuo posted him out as Southwest Route pacification commissioner.

sentences.zh: 八年，召為北院樞密使，寵任彌篤。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was recalled as Northern Court privy commissioner, and favor toward him grew ever deeper.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was recalled to serve as Northern Court privy commissioner, and the emperor's trust in him deepened further.

sentences.zh: 是時，諸路大亂，飛章告急者絡繹而至，得裏底不即上聞，有功者亦無甄別。

translations.literal: At that time every route was in great disorder; urgent memorials arrived in an unbroken stream, yet Delidi did not report them promptly to the throne, nor did he distinguish those who had merit.
translations.idiomatic: By then every frontier was in turmoil and urgent reports poured in without cease, yet Delidi neither forwarded them promptly nor singled out men who had distinguished themselves.

sentences.zh: 由是將校怨怒，人無鬥志。

translations.literal: Because of this the officers were resentful and angry, and no one had the will to fight.
translations.idiomatic: Officers grew resentful, and the army lost its fighting spirit.

sentences.zh: 保大二年，金兵至嶺東。

translations.literal: In the second year of Baoda the Jin army reached the east of the passes.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Baoda the Jin forces reached the country east of the mountain passes.

sentences.zh: 會耶律撒八、習騎撒跋等謀立晉王敖盧斡事泄，上召得裏底議曰：「反者必以此兒為名，若不除去，何以獲安。」

translations.literal: It happened that the plot of Yelü Saba, Xiqisaba, and others to set up Prince of Jin Ao Luwo was exposed; the emperor summoned Delidi to discuss the matter and said, "The rebels are sure to take this boy as their banner; if he is not removed, how can security be obtained?"
translations.idiomatic: When the plot of Yelü Saba, Xiqisaba, and others to enthrone Prince of Jin Ao Luwo came to light, the emperor called Delidi in council and said, "The rebels will surely rally under this prince; unless he is removed, how can the realm be secure?

sentences.zh: 得裏底唯唯，竟無一言申理。

translations.literal: Delidi assented vaguely and in the end spoke not a word in the prince's defense.
translations.idiomatic: Delidi murmured assent but never spoke a word in the prince's defense.

sentences.zh: 王既死，人心益離。

translations.literal: Once the prince was dead, hearts turned ever further away.
translations.idiomatic: After the prince was put to death, loyalty drained away still faster.

sentences.zh: 金兵逾嶺，天祚率衛兵西遁。

translations.literal: The Jin army crossed the passes, and Tianzuo led the palace guards in flight to the west.
translations.idiomatic: The Jin crossed the passes, and Tianzuo fled westward at the head of his palace guards.

sentences.zh: 元妃蕭氏，得裏底之侄，謂得裏底曰：「爾任國政，致君至此，何以生為！」

translations.literal: Senior Consort Xiao, Delidi's nephew's wife, said to Delidi, "You hold the reins of state and have brought the ruler to this pass—how can you go on living!"
translations.idiomatic: Senior Consort Xiao, who was married to Delidi's nephew, said to him, "You held the government in your hands and brought the sovereign to this ruin—how can you bear to go on living!

sentences.zh: 得裏底但謝罪，不能對。

translations.literal: Delidi could only beg forgiveness and had no reply.
translations.idiomatic: Delidi could only beg forgiveness and had nothing to say in reply.

sentences.zh: 明日，天祚怒，逐得裏底與其子麼撒。

translations.literal: The next day Tianzuo in anger drove off Delidi and his son Mosai.
translations.idiomatic: The next day, in anger, Tianzuo banished Delidi and his son Mosai.

sentences.zh: 得裏底既去，為耶律高山奴執送金兵。

translations.literal: After Delidi had departed, Yelü Gaoshannu seized him and handed him over to the Jin army.
translations.idiomatic: Once Delidi had left office, Yelü Gaoshannu seized him and delivered him to the Jin.

sentences.zh: 得裏底伺守者怠，脫身亡歸，復為耶律九斤所得，送之耶律淳。

translations.literal: Delidi watched for slackness among his guards, escaped and fled home, was again taken by Yelü Jiujin, and sent to Yelü Chun.
translations.idiomatic: Delidi waited until his guards grew careless, broke free and fled homeward, was seized again by Yelü Jiujin, and sent on to Yelü Chun.

sentences.zh: 時淳已僭號，得裏底自知不免，詭曰：「吾不能事僭竊之君！」

translations.literal: Chun had already usurped the title of emperor; Delidi knew he could not escape, and falsely declared, "I cannot serve a usurping, thieving ruler!"
translations.idiomatic: Chun had already proclaimed himself emperor; knowing he could not escape punishment, Delidi declared, "I will not serve a usurper who has stolen the throne!

sentences.zh: 不食數日，卒。

translations.literal: He ate nothing for several days and died.
translations.idiomatic: He refused food for several days and died.

sentences.zh: 子麼撒，為金兵所殺。

translations.literal: His son Mosai was killed by the Jin army.
translations.idiomatic: His son Mosai was slain by the Jin.

sentences.zh: 蕭酬斡，字訛裏本，國舅少父房之後。

translations.literal: Xiao Chouwo, courtesy name Eliben, was a descendant of the Younger Father branch of the Imperial Uncle clan.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Chouwo, whose courtesy name was Eliben, came from the Younger Father branch of the Imperial Uncle clan.

sentences.zh: 祖阿剌，終采訪使。

translations.literal: His grandfather Ala ended his career as investigation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Ala rose to the post of investigation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 父別裏剌，以後父封趙王。

translations.literal: His father Bielili, as father of the empress, was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: His father Bielili, as the emperor's father-in-law, was enfeoffed as Prince of Zhao.

sentences.zh: 酬斡貌雄偉，性和易。

translations.literal: Chouwo's appearance was imposing and his nature mild and easy.
translations.idiomatic: Chouwo was imposing in bearing and gentle in temperament.

sentences.zh: 年十四，尚越國公主，拜駙馬都尉，為祗候郎君班詳穩。

translations.literal: At fourteen he married the Princess of Yue, was appointed imperial son-in-law commandant, and served as detailed commander of the attendant langjun company.
translations.idiomatic: At fourteen he married the Princess of Yue, was made imperial son-in-law commandant, and became detailed commander of the attendant langjun company.

sentences.zh: 年十八，封蘭陵郡王。

translations.literal: At eighteen he was enfeoffed as Prince of Lanling commandery.
translations.idiomatic: At eighteen he was enfeoffed as Prince of Lanling.

sentences.zh: 時帝欲立皇孫為嗣，恐無以解天下疑，出酬斡為國舅詳穩，降皇后為惠妃，遷於乾州。

translations.literal: At that time the emperor wished to establish the imperial grandson as heir but feared he could not dispel the doubts of the realm; he sent Chouwo out as detailed commander of the imperial-uncle guard, demoted the empress to Graceful Consort, and moved her to Qian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor then wished to name his grandson heir but feared he could not quiet public suspicion; he posted Chouwo out as detailed commander of the imperial-uncle guard, reduced the empress to Graceful Consort, and moved her to Qian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 初酬斡母入朝，擅取驛馬，至是覺，奪其封號；

translations.literal: Earlier, when Chouwo's mother came to court she had taken relay horses without authority; this was now discovered and her title was stripped;
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when Chouwo's mother had come to court she had seized relay horses without leave; this was now discovered and her title was revoked;

sentences.zh: 復與妹魯姐為巫蠱，伏誅。

translations.literal: she again, with her younger sister Lujie, practiced witchcraft and sorcery and was executed.
translations.idiomatic: she and her younger sister Lujie were again found practicing witchcraft and were put to death.

sentences.zh: 詔酬斡與公主離婚，籍興聖宮，流烏古敵烈部。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Chouwo divorced from the princess, registered his property with the Xingsheng Palace, and exiled him to the Wugu and Dilie tribes.
translations.idiomatic: An edict divorced Chouwo from the princess, registered his household with the Xingsheng Palace, and banished him to the Wugu and Dilie tribes.

sentences.zh: 天慶中，以妹復尊為太皇太妃，召酬斡為南女直詳穩，遷征東副統軍。

translations.literal: During Tianqing, because his younger sister was again honored as Grand Imperial Senior Consort, Chouwo was recalled as detailed commander of the Southern Jurchen and transferred to deputy commander of the Eastern Expeditionary Army.
translations.idiomatic: During the Tianqing reign, when his younger sister was again elevated as Grand Imperial Senior Consort, Chouwo was recalled as detailed commander of the Southern Jurchen and promoted to deputy commander of the Eastern Expeditionary Army.

sentences.zh: 時廣州渤海作亂，乃與駙馬都尉蕭韓家奴襲其不備，平之，復敗敵將侯槩於川州。

translations.literal: At that time the Bohai of Guang Prefecture rebelled; he and the imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Hanjianu struck them unprepared and pacified them, and again defeated the enemy general Hou Kai at Chuan Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: When the Bohai of Guang Prefecture rose in revolt, he and imperial son-in-law commandant Xiao Hanjianu caught them off guard, put down the rebellion, and later defeated the enemy general Hou Kai at Chuan Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 是歲，東京叛，遇敵來擊，師潰；

translations.literal: That year the Eastern Capital rebelled; when the enemy came to attack, the army collapsed;
translations.idiomatic: That year, when the Eastern Capital rebelled, the army met the enemy's attack and broke in rout;

sentences.zh: 獨酬斡率麾下數人力戰，歿於陣，追贈龍虎衛上將軍。

translations.literal: Chouwo alone led several men under his command and fought fiercely, perishing on the field; posthumously he was given Dragon-Tiger Guard Senior General.
translations.idiomatic: Chouwo alone led a handful of his men and fought to the end, falling on the field; he was posthumously honored as Dragon-Tiger Guard Senior General.

sentences.zh: 耶律章奴，字特末衍，季父房之後。

translations.literal: Yelü Zhangnu, courtesy name Temoyan, was a descendant of the Younger Father branch.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Zhangnu, whose courtesy name was Temoyan, came from the Younger Father branch of the imperial clan.

sentences.zh: 父查剌，養高不仕。

translations.literal: His father Zhala lived in lofty retirement and did not take office.
translations.idiomatic: His father Zhala lived in cultivated seclusion and never took office.

sentences.zh: 章奴明敏善談論。

translations.literal: Zhangnu was bright and quick and skilled in discourse.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangnu was quick-witted and an able debater.

sentences.zh: 大安中，補牌印郎君。

translations.literal: In the Da'an era he was appointed a seal-and-signet langjun.
translations.idiomatic: During the Da'an reign he entered service as a seal-and-signet langjun.

sentences.zh: 乾統元年，累遷右中丞，兼領牌印宿直事。

translations.literal: In the first year of Qiantong he was promoted in succession to right vice censor-in-chief and concurrently directed palace seal-and-signet night duty.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Qiantong he rose in due course to right vice censor-in-chief and was also put in charge of palace seal-and-signet night duty.

sentences.zh: 六年，以直宿不謹，降知內客省事。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, for laxity on night duty, he was demoted to director of the Inner Guests Office.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, for negligence on night duty, he was demoted to director of the Inner Guests Office.

sentences.zh: 天慶四年，授東北路統軍副使。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianqing he was appointed deputy commander of the Northeast Route army.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Tianqing he was made deputy commander of the Northeast Route army.

sentences.zh: 五年，改同知咸州路兵馬事。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was transferred to associate commissioner of military affairs on the Xianzhou Route.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was reassigned as associate commissioner of military affairs on the Xianzhou Route.

sentences.zh: 及天祚親征女直，蕭胡篤為先鋒都統，章奴為都監。

translations.literal: When Tianzuo personally campaigned against the Jurchen, Xiao Hudu served as vanguard supreme commander and Zhangnu as army inspector.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianzuo led a personal campaign against the Jurchen, Xiao Hudu was made vanguard supreme commander and Zhangnu army inspector.

sentences.zh: 大軍渡鴨子河，章奴與魏國王淳妻兄蕭敵裏及其甥蕭延留等謀立淳，誘將卒三百餘人亡歸。

translations.literal: When the great army crossed the Yazi River, Zhangnu, with the elder brother of Prince of Wei Kingdom Chun's wife Xiao Dili and his nephew Xiao Yanliu and others, plotted to set up Chun and induced more than three hundred officers and soldiers to desert and return.
translations.idiomatic: As the main army crossed the Yazi River, Zhangnu joined with Xiao Dili, elder brother of Prince of Wei Chun's wife, and his nephew Xiao Yanliu and others in a plot to enthrone Chun, persuading more than three hundred officers and men to desert and march home.

sentences.zh: 既而天祚為女直所敗，章奴乃遣敵裏、延留以廢立事馳報淳。

translations.literal: Soon afterward Tianzuo was defeated by the Jurchen; Zhangnu then sent Dili and Yanliu to report the deposition-and-enthronement affair in haste to Chun.
translations.idiomatic: When Tianzuo was soon after defeated by the Jurchen, Zhangnu dispatched Dili and Yanliu to carry word of the planned deposition and enthronement to Chun.

sentences.zh: 淳猶豫未決。

translations.literal: Chun hesitated and could not decide.
translations.idiomatic: Chun hesitated and could not bring himself to decide.

sentences.zh: 會行宮使者乙信持天祚御劄至，備言章奴叛命，淳對使者號哭，即斬敵裏、延留首以獻天祚。

translations.literal: It happened that the mobile-palace envoy Yixin arrived bearing Tianzuo's imperial rescript, setting forth Zhangnu's rebellious orders in full; Chun wept before the envoy and at once beheaded Dili and Yanliu and presented their heads to Tianzuo.
translations.idiomatic: Just then the mobile-palace envoy Yixin arrived with an imperial rescript from Tianzuo detailing Zhangnu's treason; Chun wept before the envoy and immediately beheaded Dili and Yanliu, sending their heads to Tianzuo.

sentences.zh: 章奴見淳不從，誘草寇數百攻掠上京，取府庫財物。

translations.literal: Seeing that Chun would not follow him, Zhangnu induced several hundred bandits to attack and plunder the Upper Capital and seize the wealth of the treasury.
translations.idiomatic: When Chun refused to join him, Zhangnu rallied several hundred marauders to raid the Upper Capital and seize the treasury stores.

sentences.zh: 至祖州，率僚屬告太祖廟云：「我大遼基業，由太祖百戰而成。

translations.literal: Reaching Zu Prefecture, he led his subordinate officials to announce at the temple of Taizu, saying, "The foundation of our Great Liao was achieved through the hundred battles of Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: At Zu Prefecture he led his officers before the temple of Taizu and declared, "The foundation of our Great Liao was won through the hundred battles of Taizu.

sentences.zh: 今天下土崩，竊見興宗皇帝孫魏國王淳道德隆厚，能理世安民，臣等欲立以主社稷。

translations.literal: Today the realm is collapsing; we have observed that Xingzong Emperor's grandson, Prince of Wei Kingdom Chun, is of lofty virtue and thick moral weight and can govern the age and settle the people—we your servants wish to set him up to preside over the altars of soil and grain.
translations.idiomatic: Now the realm is crumbling; we have seen that Emperor Xingzong's grandson, Prince of Wei Chun, is a man of deep virtue who can govern the age and bring peace to the people, and we wish to set him up to rule the state.

sentences.zh: 會淳適好草甸，大事未遂。

translations.literal: It happened that Chun was just then enjoying the grassland marshalling grounds, and the great affair was not accomplished.
translations.idiomatic: But Chun happened to be away on the grasslands at sport, and the great design came to nothing.

sentences.zh: 邇來天祚惟耽樂是從，不恤萬機。

translations.literal: Of late Tianzuo has followed only indulgence in pleasure and does not attend to the myriad affairs of state.
translations.idiomatic: Of late Tianzuo has given himself only to pleasure and neglected the affairs of government.

sentences.zh: 強敵肆侮，師徒敗績。

translations.literal: A powerful enemy rampages in insult, and the army meets defeat.
translations.idiomatic: A powerful foe presses the borders, and our armies suffer defeat after defeat.

sentences.zh: 加以盜賊蜂起，邦國危於累卵。

translations.literal: Added to this, bandits swarm forth like bees, and the state is in danger like a pile of eggs.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits rise everywhere, and the state stands in peril as fragile as a tower of eggs.

sentences.zh: 臣等忝預族屬，世蒙恩渥，上欲安九廟之靈，下欲救萬民之命，乃有此舉。

translations.literal: We your servants are unworthy to share in the imperial clan yet have received favor through the generations; above we wish to settle the spirits of the nine temples, below we wish to save the lives of the myriad people—therefore we have undertaken this act.
translations.idiomatic: We, though unworthy members of the imperial clan, have received grace through generations; above we seek to secure the spirits of the ancestral temples, below we seek to save the lives of the people—this is why we have taken this step.

sentences.zh: 實出至誠，冀累聖垂佑。」

translations.literal: It truly springs from utmost sincerity, and we hope the successive sages will extend their protection."
translations.idiomatic: Our purpose is wholly sincere, and we pray that the successive sage emperors will grant their blessing.

sentences.zh: 西至慶州，復祀諸廟，仍述所以舉兵之意，移檄州縣、諸陵官僚，士卒稍稍屬心。

translations.literal: Going west to Qing Prefecture, he again sacrificed at the various temples, still setting forth the reasons for raising troops, and issued proclamations to the prefectures and counties and the officials of the imperial tombs; soldiers gradually gave him their hearts.
translations.idiomatic: He marched west to Qing Prefecture, sacrificed again at the various temples, reiterated his reasons for taking up arms, and sent proclamations to the prefectures, counties, and tomb officials; soldiers gradually rallied to his cause.

sentences.zh: 時饒州渤海及侯概等相繼來應，眾至數萬，趨廣平澱。

translations.literal: At that time the Bohai of Rao Prefecture and Hou Kai and others came to join him in succession; the host reached tens of thousands and pressed toward Guangping Marsh.
translations.idiomatic: The Bohai of Rao Prefecture, Hou Kai, and others then came over one after another; his force swelled to tens of thousands and marched toward Guangping Marsh.

sentences.zh: 其黨耶律女古等暴橫不法，劫掠婦女財畜。

translations.literal: Among his faction Yelü Nügu and others were violent, lawless, and overbearing, plundering women and livestock and goods.
translations.idiomatic: His followers, including Yelü Nügu, grew violent and lawless, seizing women, livestock, and goods.

sentences.zh: 章奴度不能制，內懷悔恨；

translations.literal: Zhangnu judged that he could not control them and inwardly harbored regret;
translations.idiomatic: Zhangnu saw he could not control them and was filled with remorse;

sentences.zh: 又攻上京不克，北走降虜。

translations.literal: again he attacked the Upper Capital without success and fled north to surrender to the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: he then failed to take the Upper Capital and fled north to surrender to the enemy.

sentences.zh: 順國女直阿鶻產率兵追敗之，殺其將耶律彌裏直，擒貴族二百餘人，其妻子配役繡院，或散諸近侍為婢；

translations.literal: The Shunguo Jurchen Ahechan led troops in pursuit, defeated him, killed his general Yelü Milizhi, and captured more than two hundred nobles; their wives and children were assigned to labor in the embroidery bureau or dispersed among the close attendants as maids;
translations.idiomatic: The Shunguo Jurchen Ahechan pursued him, routed his force, killed his general Yelü Milizhi, and captured more than two hundred nobles; their wives and children were sent to labor in the embroidery bureau or distributed among the palace attendants as servants;

sentences.zh: 余得脫者皆遁去。

translations.literal: those among the remainder who escaped all fled away.
translations.idiomatic: those who escaped fled in all directions.

sentences.zh: 章奴詐為使者，欲奔女直，為邏者所獲，縛送行在，伏誅。

translations.literal: Zhangnu pretended to be an envoy and wished to flee to the Jurchen; he was seized by patrols, bound, and sent to the mobile court, where he was executed.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangnu disguised himself as an envoy and tried to flee to the Jurchen, but patrols seized him, bound him, and sent him to the mobile court, where he was put to death.

sentences.zh: 耶律術者，字能典，於越蒲古只之後，魁偉雄辨。

translations.literal: Yelü Paizhe, courtesy name Nengdian, was a descendant of Yuyue Puguzhi, imposing in stature and bold in debate.
translations.idiomatic: Yelü Paizhe, whose courtesy name was Nengdian, was descended from Yuyue Puguzhi; he was imposing in stature and forceful in debate.

sentences.zh: 乾統初，補祗候郎君。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qiantong he was appointed an attendant langjun.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qiantong reign he entered service as an attendant langjun.

sentences.zh: 六年，因柴冊，加觀察使。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, on account of the firewood-register ceremony, he was advanced to investigation commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, for his service at the firewood-register ceremony, he was promoted to investigation commissioner.

sentences.zh: 天慶五年，受詔監都統耶律斡裏朵戰。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Tianqing he received an edict to oversee the campaigning of supreme commander Yelü Woliduo.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year of Tianqing he was ordered to oversee the campaign of supreme commander Yelü Woliduo.

sentences.zh: 及敗，左遷銀州刺史，徙咸州糺將。

translations.literal: When defeat came, he was demoted to prefect of Yin Prefecture and transferred to jiujiang commissioner at Xian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: After the defeat he was demoted to prefect of Yin and reassigned as jiujiang commissioner at Xian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 嘗與耶律章奴謀立魏國王淳。

translations.literal: He had once joined Yelü Zhangnu in plotting to set up Prince of Wei Kingdom Chun.
translations.idiomatic: He had once joined Yelü Zhangnu in a plot to enthrone Prince of Wei Chun.

sentences.zh: 及聞章奴自鴨子河亡去，即引麾下數人往會之。

translations.literal: When he heard that Zhangnu had fled away from the Yazi River, he at once led several men under his command to join him.
translations.idiomatic: When he learned that Zhangnu had deserted from the Yazi River, he immediately took a few of his men and went to join him.

sentences.zh: 道為遊兵所執，送行在所。

translations.literal: On the road he was seized by roving troops and sent to the mobile court.
translations.idiomatic: On the way he was seized by roving troops and brought to the mobile court.

sentences.zh: 上問曰：「予何負卿而反？」

translations.literal: The emperor asked, "What have I done against you that you rebel?"
translations.idiomatic: The emperor asked, "What wrong have I done you that you would rebel?

sentences.zh: 術者對曰：「臣誠無憾。

translations.literal: Paizhe replied, "Your servant truly has no resentment.
translations.idiomatic: Paizhe answered, "Your servant bears no personal grievance.

sentences.zh: 但以天下大亂，已非遼有，小人滿朝，賢臣竄斥，誠不忍見天皇帝艱難之業一旦土崩。

translations.literal: But the realm is in great disorder and is no longer possessed by Liao; petty men fill the court and worthy ministers are driven off in exile—I truly cannot bear to see the hard-won enterprise of the Heaven Emperor suddenly crumble to earth.
translations.idiomatic: But the realm is in chaos and Liao no longer holds it; petty men fill the court while worthy ministers are driven into exile. I could not bear to watch the Heaven Emperor's hard-won enterprise collapse in a single day.

sentences.zh: 臣所以痛入骨髓而有此舉，非為身計。」

translations.literal: Your servant's pain entered the marrow of the bones and produced this act—not for his own advantage."
translations.idiomatic: My grief went to the bone, and that is why I acted—not for my own gain."

sentences.zh: 後數日，復問，術者厲聲數上過惡，陳社稷危亡之本，遂殺之。

translations.literal: Several days later he was questioned again; Paizhe in a harsh voice recounted the emperor's faults, set forth the root of the altars' peril and ruin, and was then put to death.
translations.idiomatic: Several days later the emperor questioned him again; Paizhe raised his voice, listed the emperor's faults one by one, laid bare the roots of the state's ruin, and was then executed.

sentences.zh: 論曰：遼末同事之臣，其善惡何相遠也！

translations.literal: The commentary says: Among the ministers who served together at the end of Liao, how far apart their good and evil were!
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: Among the ministers who served together at the end of Liao, how vast was the distance between good and evil!

sentences.zh: 棠古骨鯁不屈權要，兩鎮烏古，恩威並著。

translations.literal: Tanggu was firm as a bone and would not yield to the powerful; twice he governed Wugu, and both favor and awe were manifest.
translations.idiomatic: Tanggu was unbending before the mighty, governed Wugu twice, and won renown through both kindness and sternness.

sentences.zh: 酬斡平亂渤海，又以討叛力戰而死，忠可尚矣。

translations.literal: Chouwo pacified the Bohai rebellion and again, in suppressing rebellion, fought fiercely and died—his loyalty is worthy of esteem.
translations.idiomatic: Chouwo put down the Bohai rebellion and later died fighting rebels in the field—loyalty worthy of respect.

sentences.zh: 得裏底縱女直而不討，寢變告而不聞，其蔽主聰明，為國階亂，莫斯之甚也。

translations.literal: Delidi indulged the Jurchen without punishing them, let urgent reports of change lie unheeded, obscured the ruler's clarity, and made the state a stairway to disorder—none went further than he.
translations.idiomatic: Delidi indulged the Jurchen without striking, buried urgent reports without hearing them, clouded the ruler's judgment, and set the state on the path to ruin—none did more harm.

sentences.zh: 章奴、術者乘時多艱，潛謀廢立，將求寵幸，以犯大逆，其得免於天下之戮哉！

translations.literal: Zhangnu and Paizhe, taking advantage of a time of many hardships, secretly plotted deposition and enthronement, intending to seek favor and fortune, and in committing great treason—how could they escape the punishment of the realm!
translations.idiomatic: Zhangnu and Paizhe, seizing a time of hardship, secretly plotted deposition and enthronement in hope of personal gain, and by committing high treason—how could they hope to escape the punishment of the realm!
